svg.aria-label: Bode plot of K s squared over (1 + 0.2s)(1 + 0.02s): with K = 1 the asymptote climbs at 40 dB per decade to 28 dB at the corner 5 rad/s, then 20 dB per decade to 48 dB at 50 rad/s, then flat; shifting the whole curve down by 28 dB (K = 0.04) puts the gain crossover at 5 rad/s; the phase falls from 180 to 0 degrees
svg.title: Bode plot of K s squared over (1 + 0.2s)(1 + 0.02s): with K = 1 the asymptote climbs at 40 dB per decade to 28 dB at the corner 5 rad/s, then 20 dB per decade to 48 dB at 50 rad/s, then flat; shifting the whole curve down by 28 dB (K = 0.04) puts the gain crossover at 5 rad/s; the phase falls from 180 to 0 degrees

g.text: blue: K = 1 · pink: K = 10^(−28/20) = 0.04 · dashed: asymptotes · e to j: the phase table points
